title: Azusawa Kohane — Can't Wait For The Show〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you for showing us all those wonderful Christmas pictures, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you as well. I had a lot of fun talking about what happened.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
You took so many good pictures♪
I really loved the one where everyone was visibly moved!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Why are you looking at me...?
It was a pretty spectacular scene, so I think it's safe to say that we were all moved by it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
He's right.
You shouldn't tease someone for giving an honest reaction.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Still, Kamishiro really is an incredible director.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I wasn't sure what was gonna happen after they got the news that the truck carrying their equipment got stuck in the snow.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But he definitely deserves credit for coming up with a replacement idea on the spot like that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Come to think of it, he did something similar when you helped with the flash mob for that wedding, right, Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, you were there to fill in for someone else, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. After Kamishiro heard that I'd be taking Tsukasa's place, he got a bit worried and came to see how I was doing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
He even ended up helping direct the flash mob.
Fortunately, we were able to accomplish our task.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
That was pretty hectic.
You told me all of a sudden to come over and dance with you guys.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was just passing by, and I ended up dancing while wearing a tuxedo.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You've told us that story a number of times already, but it always sounds like it was a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's because it was!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The best part was how we got all these people who were just walking nearby and had nothing to do with the wedding to come and dance with us!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. It's hard not to want to join in when you see so many others enjoying themselves.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
How do I put it...?
It's like Kamishiro really gets people and knows exactly what would be the most fun for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He gets people, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, did I say something funny just now?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, it's just... He knows how to get people to have fun, but he also has a talent for really pressing your buttons...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Actually, forget I said that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, the performance we put on for the sports festival was also really awesome.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, you mean for the cheering competition?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! When he said he was gonna have a few of us jump out of the windows, we all thought it'd be way too dangerous.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But he made sure that we could pull that stunt off safely, and he was there every step of the way during practice.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's as if he's able to use his creativity to make the impossible possible...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Again, he really is an incredible director.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: He is!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But he does also like to bring a lot of weird things to school and run strange experiments.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Weird things? Strange experiments...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, why does he do all this dangerous stuff whenever he's not putting on shows?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Dangerous...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Haha!
Kohane and Toya seem completely lost.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: To be fair, Kohane doesn't know about the things Kamishiro does during the day and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But you should.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You saw him and Tsukasa get chased around by the teachers just the other day.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, but...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: When I tried baking those cupcakes a while back, Kamishiro was the one who gave me advice on how to make them better.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, he does stand out at school, but I see him as one of the most reliable seniors I know.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And based on what he said when we talked about the Christmas show, he just felt like a really nice person to me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I mean, he seemed determined to put on a good show and send everyone home smiling.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, but...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We get that, but...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I believe he's able to come up with all these different ideas because his knowledge is so vast.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, and his curiosity drives him to test things himself. Much more than his peers.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hear that?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: These two are so pure...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Luka & MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe.
